# Data Retention Standard

## 1. Purpose

This standard sets how long Acme keeps each kind of record.

## 2. Requirements

### 2.1 General

1. Records are kept no longer than they are needed.
1. Records needed for a legal claim are kept until the claim ends.
1. Every disposal is recorded.

### 2.2 Exceptions

Acme keeps records longer only:

(1) when the law requires it; or

(2) when a regulator asks for it.

**Right to object**

You can object to how long we keep your records.

***Who to contact***

Write to the Data Protection Officer.

## 3. Review

To review this standard:

1. collect the year's disposal records;
2. compare them with this standard.

Then, separately:

1. report what the review found;
2. update the standard.
